content: For local Docker+SQLite personal finance apps, Hono+Vite+React+Drizzle+better-sqlite3 is the pragmatic 2025-2026 stack: single Node process serves API+SPA, sync SQLite fits better-sqlite3, volume mount for DB file, migrate at container start. Next.js standalone also works but adds SSR/App Router weight unnecessary for single-user local tools. TanStack Start+libsql appears in newer deploy docs.
